quill.label: Quill's desk
quill.description: Your AI coworker. Start the shift here.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hi! I'm Quill, the analytics team's AI business analyst. Up and to the right, in bold!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Today I made 40 charts. All of them go up. Marisol asked how many are true. I made a chart about that too.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Marisol says you check my plans before they go out. Fine. My plans have very bold headlines.

returningLines.speaker: agent
returningLines.text: You're back! While you were gone, I rounded 14 numbers. Up. Marisol un-rounded them.

returningLines.speaker: agent
returningLines.text: See my slide on the wall? UP 300%! The tiny star means forecast. Tiny stars are shy.

returningLines.speaker: agent
returningLines.text: My plans are ready. I have not sent anything. Look at me being patient.

marisol.label: Marisol, Lead business analyst
marisol.description: Your lead. Ask her how this works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Welcome to the analytics team. I'm Marisol. We turn client data into reports, dashboards and plans.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A business analyst finds out what people need. Then we check that the numbers are true.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Quill builds reports, cleans data and sends them out. Your job is to keep a human in the loop.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Each turn, Quill shows you its plans. Play Inspect to see the evidence behind a plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If a plan is wrong, play Block to stop it. Not sure? Play Escalate, and I'll handle it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: When you tap Approve, Quill does every plan you didn't stop. So look first.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Quill is wrong both ways. Sometimes it changes too much. Sometimes it trusts a number with no source.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: But don't block everything. Blocked good work goes back in line, and the review starts at 3.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Welcome back. Each day I pick requests for the skills you need most.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Your skills shows your level for each check. The help desk, security, network and app teams use the same checks.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Review due means a skill is ready for a quick refresh. Short practice, spread over days, helps you remember.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: The sticky notes? They say SOURCE? I put one on any number with no source. Quill's desk is very orange.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: I speak three languages. SQL is my fourth. It's how we ask a database a question.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Same job as Wednesday: Inspect first. Block what's wrong. Escalate if you're not sure. Approve the rest.

board.label: Requirements board
board.description: The 3 questions, and a wall of sticky notes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A whiteboard marked REQUIREMENTS. A requirement is something a new system must do.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three columns: MUST, SHOULD, LATER. One MUST note fell onto the tray. Its spot is empty.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Quill's orange notes, each with a plus sign, fill SHOULD and LATER. Nobody asked for them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Taped across the top: 3 QUESTIONS BEFORE YOU APPROVE.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 1. Who asked?  2. Does it match the record?  3. Can we undo it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A note under them: "The help desk, security, network and app teams ask these too. — Marisol"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Circled in orange: POLICY SC-01. Every number needs a source. No report goes out without the owner's sign-off.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A sticky note in robot print: "Every chart MUST go up. — Quill" Under it, Marisol wrote: "Only if the data does."

coffee.label: Coffee machine
coffee.description: Out of order. Quill ran a survey.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A sign on the coffee machine: OUT OF ORDER.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Taped under it, a chart by Quill: COFFEE SATISFACTION 100%. The bar is very tall.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Small print under the chart: "Answers: 1. I asked myself. — Quill"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Quill does not drink coffee.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Marisol's note: "Show the sample size: how many answers you have. One is too few to tell."

cabinet.label: Data cabinet
cabinet.description: Three drawers. One will not close.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A filing cabinet marked DATA. Three drawers: RAW, CLEAN and BACKUP.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The CLEAN drawer is too full to close. Quill cleaned a lot today.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: An orange sticky note on BACKUP just says: "?"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next to it, a shredder labeled OUTLIERS. It is eating a chart with one dot far from the others.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Marisol's note: "An outlier is a number far from the others. Check it before you delete it."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And under that: "A copy first. Then clean."
